variants.title: The AI is wrong.
variants.support: A tricky platformer. A very confident opponent.
variants.headline: Outsmart the AI
variants.primaryText: The AI has predicted your failure. Very confidently. Again. Move, jump, and Rewrite your way through 20 levels in EXCEPTION: HUMAN.
variants.shortCaption: The AI is wrong. Your next jump can prove it.

variants.title: The floor quit.
variants.support: Rewrite missing ground. Cross before it expires.
variants.headline: Rewrite your escape
variants.primaryText: Missing floor? Inconvenient. Rewrite it into a temporary bridge, make the jump, and leave the AI to update its excuses. EXCEPTION: HUMAN.
variants.shortCaption: Move. Jump. Rewrite. Please stop invalidating the model.

variants.title: It blames you.
variants.support: You bring persistence. It brings excuses.
variants.headline: An AI with an ego
variants.primaryText: Bad predictions. Missing floors. Excellent excuses. Take on a stubborn AI in EXCEPTION: HUMAN, a tricky platformer with 20 campaign levels and four extra challenges.
variants.shortCaption: Twenty levels. One AI that will never admit this was its fault.
